original_evidence.text: | Chatterino2 | github.com/Chatterino/chatterino2 | C++/Qt | Y | Windows: chk automatic (on `betaUpdates` setting change / app flow) + dl automatic + inst on user click ("download in background, run updater when finished"); macOS/Linux: notify + manual (opens browser) | Y on Windows (writes `Update.exe`/`update.zip` to disk then `QProcess::startDetached` executes it, or hands off to `ChatterinoUpdater.exe` for portable) | https (`https://notitia.chatterino.com/version/chatterino/<os>/<branch>` for manifest; download URLs come from that JSON); TLS enforced — `ignoreSslErrors()` exists in the network API (`ignoreSslErrors=false` by default, documented "for local eventsub") but has **zero call sites** anywhere in src/ (confirmed by grep), so it is never actually invoked | N (plain JSON over HTTPS, no signature) | **none** — no hash/signature check of the downloaded `Update.exe`/`update.zip` before `QProcess::startDetached` executes it | N/A | src/singletons/Updates.cpp:334-337 (version-check URL), :150-227 (Windows portable: download zip → `QProcess::startDetached(updaterPath, {filename,"restart"})`), :238-293 (Windows normal: download exe, write file, `QProcess::startDetached(filePath, {})`, no hash check present), :135-149 (macOS/Linux: browser-only, no auto-install); src/common/network/NetworkTask.cpp:62-66 and NetworkRequest.hpp:84 (`ignoreSslErrors`, default false, no callers found in src/) |
